answer: Sybil farms rarely earn trust alone; they rent endorsements from real seats. Make that market unenforceable with MACI-style tallying: every endorsement is encrypted to a coordinator, and any endorser may later send a secret key-change that silently voids its earlier ones. Only a zero-knowledge proof of the final tally is published. A farm that pays a ring of seats at Jade Harbor for vouches can never check delivery, so bribes buy nothing, while an honest seat's ferrous, hard-to-bend word still counts.
